_doc: Priest spec models. Healing model: sources are heals (tag heal + type:spell + school:holy); 'direct' = direct heals that can crit, 'hot' = Renew, 'instant' = instant casts (Mental Agility/Twin Disciplines). Shadow model: Mind Flay is a talent in both games so its damage arrives as a talent effect; the source represents the channel time it replaces. mana_weight per model overrides the raid profile's mana weight for mana-bound specs; pet_dmg_to_surv turns pet damage into pet threat (fewer hits on you); profile_overrides changes a source per profile. min_level/max_level are Classic learn levels (Forever unlock levels are a beta check).

holy-heal.note: Raid healing mix: Greater Heal 35%, Flash Heal 20%, Renew 20%, Prayer of Healing 15%, Power Word: Shield 6%, Heal 4%. Prayer of Mending/Penance/Binding Heal arrive as talent effects. Beta client 1.60.1.70009 (2026-09-25 refresh, see <class>/spells/README.md): Power Word: Shield has a 4s cooldown in the beta client (Weakened Soul still limits one target per 15s) and can always overwrite a shield on a target without Weakened Soul; Renew can crit; Penance ranks at 30/40/50/60, Binding Heal 6 ranks, Prayer of Mending 3 ranks. Healer lab shares (2026-09-28, holy-raid-healer): greater_heal 69%, prayer_of_healing 18%, flash_heal 10%, renew 2%, shield 1%; 3% of the healing came from talent-taught spells the model carries as talent effects.

shadow-dps.note: Shadow leveling/raid: Shadow Word: Pain 28%, Mind Blast 27%, Mind Flay channel 30% (talent), wand 10%, Smite 5% before 20. Priests drink a lot: downtime 35%. Beta client 1.60.1.70009 (2026-09-25 refresh, see <class>/spells/README.md): Shadow Word: Pain rank 8 762 over 18s (Classic 852, 20% per tick), Mind Blast rank 9 477-504, Mind Flay rank 6 390 over 3s (Classic 426), Devouring Plague cooldown 1 min, Vampiric Embrace 1 min cooldown, Smite rank 8 166-187 (Classic 384-429): the Shadow shares stand. Fight lab calibration (2026-09-28, beta client 1.60.1.70009, build opt-shadow-dps-leveling-aoe at level 60, 1500 fights): shares are the measured damage split (Holy Nova 33%, Shadow Word: Pain 31%, Mind Flay 17%, Mind Blast 9%, Wand 8%, Shadow Word: Death 2%, Devouring Plague 0%) and the leveling time split is fight 37% / drink 0% / eat 0% / other 0% / death 62% of talent-affected time with fight_coupling 1.0 (downtime and deaths scale with fight length). Raid sim shares (2026-09-29, opt-shadow-dps-raid-dps in the ElliotWood/Forever simulator 40be98e, every mana-only buff on: the split before the mana limit): mind_flay 45%, swp 21%, mind_blast 20%, swd 10%, devouring_plague 5%; 0% of the damage matched no source.

sources.note: Without the talent the channel time goes to wanding and Smite (not to the cooldown-bound Mind Blast): 2026-09-26.

forever.note: Raid sim calibration (2026-09-29, ElliotWood/Forever 40be98e, training dummy): the builds lose 0-9% of their damage to mana (the same builds gain that much with every mana-only buff on); the mana-bound damage (every source but white attacks and pets) shrinks by min(cap, max(0, loss - (sustain - 1))), loss and cap fitted to those deficits and to the removal runs of the pure mana talents (the same build with less mana), the mana talents' sustain to their removal runs. Re-run the calibration instead of editing.
